core_obligations: Fibres over kappa (proof lines 3918-3934): kappa is a finite extension of k with [kappa : k]_s geometric fibres C_t, each with H^0 = overline{k}; set-theoretically C_{overline{k}} is the union of the C_t, so g_geom(C/k) is the sum over the [kappa : k]_s fibres.
Cohomology matching (proof lines 3936-3944): flat base change gives dim_{overline{k}} H^1(C_t, O_{C_t}) = dim_kappa H^1(C, O_C) for every fibre.

Normalization comparison (proof lines 3946-3956): the normalization C_t^nu is the disjoint union of the models of the components of C_t, so dim H^1 of it is g_geom(C_t/overline{k}); lemma-genus-goes-down bounds that by dim H^1(C_t, O_{C_t}), and summing finishes the proof.
proof_roadmap: Decompose the geometric fibre into the [kappa : k]_s fibres over the embeddings of kappa.
Match H^1 dimensions across the base change by flat base change.
Decompose each normalization into component models and identify the geometric genus.
Apply the genus-goes-down inequality and sum over the fibres.
